amendment_1.change: producer-digest echo law: the request line carries input_digest computed by the producer (Python) from its stored state + requested_model via its canonical_json; the TS adapter validates the 64-hex format, echoes it verbatim in every response line and cache entry, and MUST NOT recompute it; Python ingest recomputes from its own state (authoritative) and compares to the echo - mismatch => SCHEMA_ERROR incident (as before, but now only one side ever formats floats)
amendment_1.reason: A7-1 F1 (CRITICAL): cross-language float-formatting divergence measured 10/25 (40%) on real prepared request lines - Python json.dumps renders doubles as 1e-05/1.234e-07/5e-06/34.0 while TS JSON.stringify renders 0.00001/1.234e-7/0.000005/34, so the TS-side recompute produced different sha256 digests for the same state and would have fail-closed ~40% of billable calls to TRANSITION_UNKNOWN after the money was spent

request_line.input_digest: 64 lowercase hex; REQUIRED; computed by the PRODUCER (Python) as sha256(canonical_json(state)||requested_model) via its own canonical_json (amendment_1)

response_line.input_digest: VERBATIM ECHO of the request line's producer-computed input_digest; the adapter MUST NOT recompute it; Python ingest recomputes from its own state (authoritative) and compares - mismatch => SCHEMA_ERROR incident (amendment_1)
